title: Antonio Bellon was my friend
article: A letter from Norbert Dutra, Toronto.
I want people to know that Antonio Bellon was more than what you read in those news reports.
Tony Bellon was my soccer coach. Tony Bellon was my friend. Only 11, and new to organized sports, I was very nervous about fitting in and proving myself among kids who had been on the team for years.

It was Tony who put me at ease. He was a great coach; warm and engaging. He was quick with a smile, had an easy laugh and liked to joke with us. This is not to say we weren't successful; under Tony's guidance we won the championship in my first year. This is how I prefer to remember Tony.

In the following years I lost touch with him. Though I only knew him for a short time, he had a great impact on my life. I never did get around to telling him how much he meant to me. I regret that very much now.
